week2.2: S umata ur yelli ara abeddel ajeṭṭan yeqqnen ɣer lḥemla deg acelḍ-a.
week2.3: Wakud ummid n ovulation yemgarad seg yiwen ɣer wayeḍ, daymi tallit-a tezga d ayen ittwakayyad.

week3.0: Ma usemmed yeḍra, ibiḍ yebda ad yetfarraq yerna ad iddu ɣer taddart n tkuffa, maca ulac kra yettwafen yakan s uḥedqen n lḥemla.
week3.1: Dduls-a tezga deg tallit n uḥsab n ṭṭbib yeqqnen ɣer usemmed; ulac ccaɣel ajeṭṭan yettwaḥessen s umata deg acelḍ-a.
week3.2: Aṭas n yihedqenen n lḥemla n umalas ttuɣalen d iyettwaḍmanen seg dduls i d-yeḍfer, ticki ujerreb yebda.

week4.0: Ageddid amecṭuḥ yezwar yeqqen deg ugdil n tkuffa. Taxsayt n lmayeε d taxsayt n tmellalt, i ara t-yeččen deg ussan imezwura, ttbedun ad d-ttwaxdment.
week4.3: Kra n medden ur ẓrint ara kra n yimenan akka tura deg acelḍ-a ameẓyan.
week4.4: Ahedqen n lḥemla n umalas izmer ad d-yeldi lḥemla s umata seg dduls-a.
week4.5: D akud amatu ideg ahedqen n lḥemla izmer ad yebdu ad d-yefk agmuḍ yelhan.

week5.0: Anagraw n tawwurt-ik yebda ad yeddu, yerna wul, mazal d amecṭuḥ, ad yebdu ad yettekki i tikkelt tamezwarut.
week5.3: Aṭṭan uslig, aḥrad amecṭuḥ n uḍfel neɣ ucemmus n ufud zemren ad d-banen.
week5.4: D wakud i d-yettunefken i wakken ad tfeṛṣeḍ asgen n tamusni n ṭṭbib akken ad tebduḍ ukeččum n lḥemla.

week6.0: Iɣerbalen n yifassen d yiḍaren d-banen, d ibeẓẓaren imecṭuḥen deg ara d-yili usemmaṭ n yiseɛdan. Wul izmer ad yettwaf yakan s ultrason.
week6.3: Aḥrad d usexsi zemren ad ggarden i kra n medden deg wakud-a.
week6.4: Armud n wul izmer ad yettwaf kra n tikkal seg ddasen-a s ultrason imezwura.

week7.0: Aɣerrabu yettalay ugar n ayen n ujeṭṭa, ayen i d-yefkan iẓem amecṭuḥ. Iɣerbalen imecṭuḥen n ifassen ttbedun ad d-banen deg taggara n iɣerfan.
week7.3: Ugzam ixeddmen n lqut neɣ ayen yettwaɛeddan n kra n yimekli yezmer ad yili.
week7.4: Ajeṭṭan n anagraw, ayen i d-yeqqimen d aɣerrabu d ujeṭṭa n uzargu, yezga ittekkat deg ddasen-a.

week8.0: Ageddid yettusemma tura d aqcic. Iɣerfan ttwaɣellten, iqerru ittbeddu ad izuzzer, yerna lmeṣra yezga ittuxdam.
week8.3: Ixsas n iɣerrabun d ucemmus n uzaglu ttilin deg acelḍ-a, maca mačči i yal yiwen.
week8.4: Ahedqen amezwaru n wass n ulli yettwasbedd s umata gar ddasen 8 ɣer 14.

week9.0: Iɣerbalen n udmawen ttbanen mliḥ, iɣerbal ttḥerzen allen, yerna ifassen d iḍaren ttuxdamen d wuẓaren n ikalasen.
week9.3: Aḥrad d usexsi aṭas zemren ad qqimen; ttnaqqṣen s umata ɣer taggara n tlata n yibeddan n lḥemla.
week9.4: Iɛeḍman n lḥasin ttbedun ad ttemgaradent, maca lǧens ur d-yettbin ara s umata armi d yirgazen, deg ultrason n usaḍar.

week10.0: Udem yettuɣal d ayen i d-yettwassen ugar, iɣerbal ttḥessen s tafat, yerna wul yettekkat s wudem uzzir, azal n tlata n tikkal i uzzir n ukbir.
week10.3: Lḥewṛ-ik izmer ad yebdu ad yettbeddil cwiṭ, ula ma uḍfel ur d-yettbin ara akka tura.
week10.4: Asenqed amezwaru n tlata n wayyuren yeqqnen, ma yettunefk, yettxeddem s umata gar ddasen 11 ɣer 14.

week11.0: Iḍudan n ifassen d iḍaren ttfarqen, iɣecfan imecṭuḥen ttbanen, yerna lmeṣra yettawi cwiṭ cwiṭ amkan n taxsayt n tmellalt deg uččuy n uḍfel.
week11.3: Tzemreḍ ad tẓreḍ abeddel n wul, i d-yeqqnen ladɣa ɣer ubeddel n hormone.
week11.4: Ukkus n uqcic yebda, maca s umata ur yettwaḥessen ara deg acelḍ-a.

week12.0: Iɛeḍman n lǧuf d ikalasen sεan taɣessa, yerna ukalet yebda ad yettaḥaḍ. Iɛeḍman n tuffɣa xedmen yakan, maca ur d-banen ara deg ultrason akka tura.
week12.3: Uzaglu s umata ittnaqqaṣ cwiṭ cwiṭ deg wakud-a, ula ma yemgarad aṭas seg yiwen ɣer wayeḍ.
week12.4: Taggara n tlata n wayyuren tettwaqqen s umata ɣer uqaṭṭar n lmeskel amecṭuḥ ma yettwasebded ɣer ddasen i izwaren.

week13.0: Ukkus, mazal yettawi, yettuɣal d ayen yeqqnen cwiṭ. Kra n yiqcicen sεan yakan arrad n ummus n uḍar.
week13.3: Aṭas n medden ttaɣalen cwiṭ cwiṭ i tezmert cwiṭ ugar mi ara yeqreb wayyur wis sin.
week13.4: Wayyur amezwaru n lḥemla yekfa s umata ɣer ddasen-a; aḥrad yettkemmil s ussan n wuffir imbaɛden.

week14.0: Iqerru yettuɣal d ayen yeqqnen ugar d lǧuf. Aqcic yettɣimmi cwiṭ n waman n lmayeε, ayen yettɛeddin deg tikuffa d ukan.
week14.3: Uḍfel ittbedu ad yettbeddil ugar i kra n medden.
week14.4: Unelmad n tezmert izmer kra n tikkal ad yebdu ad isel i wul s ukamil n ultrason yettwasbedden ɣer uḍfel.

week15.0: Aqucuy ameẓyan yettwassen d lanugo ittbedu ad yeqqim ɣef weglim, yerna iɣerfan d tekkamin ttbanen. Allen ttuɣalen d iḥessasen i tafat.
week15.3: Lbɣi-ik n imekli izmer ad yettbeddil, kra n tikkal s ugzam neɣ ur nelli ara n kra n yimekli.
week15.4: Asel yebda ad d-yettalay ɣer ddasen-a: taɣect-ik d yiɣbaren n ujeṭṭa ttbedun ad ttwasselen cwiṭ cwiṭ.

week16.0: Anagraw n tawwurt yeǧǧa armud n ifassen d iḍaren. Ifassen zemren ad ččiren d isɛa imecṭuḥen.
week16.3: Kra n medden ttbeddun ad ḥessen armud amecṭuḥ aṭas seg ddasen-a, yettwaglem am ussu n lǧennact.
week16.4: Ahessi n yimudar imezwura yemgarad aṭas seg yiwen ɣer wayeḍ, ladɣa ma d lḥemla tamezwarut neɣ ala.

week17.0: Allen, mazal ttemǧan, zemrent ad ttmudden, yerna aqcic yettqabal tura ɣer yimesla iẓeggwaɣen. Ifassen ttbedun ad ttuxdamen.
week17.3: Aṭṭan n ufud amecṭuḥ izmer ad d-yili ticki asmuddi n ukuref yettbeddil.
week17.4: Iɣbaren n berra ttbedun ad ttwasselen, d iffiren, ɣer uwaman n lmayeε.

week18.0: Asel, ahdez, aḥwi d ammus yettkemmilen ad xedmen. Aqcic yettuɣal d aɣelnaw ugar d ugar, s ugar n yimudar n ifassen d iḍaren.
week18.3: Uḍfel d aṭas ittbin ddasen-a, yerna uzzel n uzzel-ik ittkemmil abeddel.
week18.4: Ultrason n usaḍar, ittwazen asenqed amatu n ukayad n uqcic, yettwabder s umata gar ddasen 18 ɣer 21.

week19.0: Isɛa n weswir ittbeddun ad ttwaxdament deffir wid n lbeṛṛani i ttuheyyiɣen, yerna aqcic yettkemmil ad yettaru azal.
week19.3: Ahettu n ujeṭṭan ɣef yidmaren n uḍfel (aṭṭan n tgecrart tamecṭuḥt) izmer ad d-yili ticki taddart n tkuffa tettaru.
week19.4: D wakud amatu i usurez n armud n uqcic ugar s tefses.

week20.0: Seg ddasen-a, azal ittwaḥseb seg uqerru ɣer uḍar, mačči seg uqerru ɣer uɣerfan, acku iḍaren zemren ad ttwaɣellen yerna ad ttwaḥsben — aya yefka tiɣerɣert ittbin deg useqqamu n ukayad mgal ddasen iɛeddan.
week20.3: Uḍfel-ik yettuɣal d aɣerdayan yezmer ad yesεu aḍrar ɣef usaḍuf d wudem-ik.
week20.4: Ammas n lḥemla yettwaεerḍ s umata s usenqed ummid ɣer unelmad n tezmert i yettḥerrin.

week21.0: Armud yettuɣal d ayen yeqqnen ugar d ayen ittunefken, yerna d ayen imatu ad yebdu ad yettwaḥess s tefses deg tallit-a.
week21.3: Ugzam amecṭuḥ n uḍfel s ukayad izmer ad d-yili ticki taddart n tkuffa teččur ugar.
week21.4: Asnan n uṭṭan n armud n uqcic ittuɣal d ayen yeqqnen yeḥrez ad d-yettwaf abeddel ur nelli ara am wakken yella.

week22.0: Idamen ttkemmilen ad xeddment, yerna aqcic yettuɣal d aɣelnaw n armud amecṭuḥ n uddurar. Tiluẓin n tmeɣrut daɣen ttbeddun ad ttwaxdament.
week22.3: Imawalen n iḍaren, ladɣa deg yiḍ, zemren ad d-banen i kra n medden.
week22.4: Ayen i d-tečč yezmer ad yesεu aḍrar ɣef waman n lmayeε, i yettarwa uqcic s umata.

week23.0: Iḍaren tura ttwaḥsaben mliḥ. Aqcic yettwehhu ad yettnefsi yerna yebda ad yettbeddil gar tallit n unuba d tallit n wul.
week23.3: Aṭṭan n ufud ameqqran izmer ad d-yili s tuɣalin n lzzayed n azal.
week23.4: Tuffɣa n tallit n tmeɣrut d tallit n unuba n uqcic ak-yeɛawen ad tessneḍ aswir-is.

week24.0: Aqcic yewwi ɣer ubdar n tudert: ma yella tuffɣa tazzayezt aṭas deg acelḍ-a, unelmad n tezmert n yemmudnen yeqqnen izmer ad yeǧǧ tudert, s tallit yelhan.
week24.3: Ugzam ɣef ubalun d lbɣi n ukacem s tikkelt zemren ad d-banen.
week24.4: Asenqed n ssuker n lḥemla yettunefk s umata deg wakud-a.

week25.0: Aqcic yettqabal tura ɣer yimesla iẓeggwaɣen s ugdal neɣ s waɣbar, yerna zemren ad ttwaḥessen kra n wuccan. Yettnunneḍ s tfunast deg waman n lmayeε.
week25.3: Ugraw n tmeɣrut neɣ ibaleɛ n lḥemla zemren ad ttilin ugar.
week25.4: Wuccan n uqcic i yettwaḥessen seg wakud ɣer wayeḍ ttwaḥsaben d imatu.

week26.0: Allen ldint i tikkelt tamezwarut. Ccekl-nsent aneggaru ur yettwassen ara s umata armi yekfa kra n wayyuren deffir tlalit.
week26.3: Ahettu amecṭuḥ n yiɛeḍman neɣ n iḍaren izmer ad d-yili, ladɣa deg taggara n wass.
week26.4: Wayyur wis tlata yeqreb, yerna anelmad ittwaweṭṭen yettuɣal d ugar s umata.

week27.0: Idamen ttuɣalen d wid izemren ad bdun anfas, yerna aqcic yettkemmil ad yettwaxdam am wakken yettuzzu zzit n ukalet n weglim.
week27.3: Usexsi izmer ad d-yuɣal ticki ajeṭṭa-ik yewwi azal yettilin ugar.
week27.4: Tazwara n wayyur wis tlata d tallit yelhan akken ad tbeddu ad tmektiḍ ɣef ahil n tlalit.

week28.0: Uzzir n wul, yelli iẓegger deg tazwara n lḥemla, yeqqim ɣer 130 ɣer 140 n tikkelt deg tesdidt yerna tura izmer ad d-yettwasel s ustetoscope.
week28.3: Ugzam n anfas neɣ aɣbaleɛ n lḥemla zemren ad ttilin ugar ticki taddart n tkuffa teččur ugar.
week28.4: Wayyur wis tlata yebda s umata ɣer ddasen-a, s ussan n wuffir ttuɣalen d ugar.

week29.0: Aqcic yebna yakan mliḥ; ddasen i d-yeḍfern ad d-sseqdacent akka kan i uɣelnaw n iɛeḍman d uzmil n uzal. Aɣecc ameẓyan i yeggugen aglim-is ittbeddu ad yettwaṣfar.
week29.3: Nnuba izmer ad yuɣal d aṭṭan ɣef sebba n uḍfel-ik i d-yettilin.
week29.4: Asemmaḍ ɣef uzelmaḍ yettunefk s umata deg taggara n lḥemla i usnejmeṛ n unnuba.

week30.0: Tamuɣli tettkemmil ad texdem; mi ara d-yili uqcic, ad izmer ad iẓer udmawen i yeqqnen, send ad yeɣleb ad yettwehhu ad yeḍfer iɣerfan i yettmudden.
week30.3: Ahettu n lekmal deg uḍfel neɣ deg ukalas izmer ad yettilin ugar.
week30.4: Ussan n wuffir n ukayad ttuɣalen d ugar s umata seg ddasen-a.

week31.0: Aqcic yettmudden s tezmert, kra n tikkal yettččuf ifassen-is, yerna izmer ad ixdem armud ameqqran. Aglim-is yettuɣal d amecṭuḥ i wacu n ukalet i d-yettwarnan.
week31.3: Tuffɣa n yimudar n usnaleɛ, i yettusemman Braxton Hicks, zemrent ad ttbeddunt ad ttwaḥessent kra n tikkal.
week31.4: Aqcic ittbedu ad iεqel kra n yimesla yettwasnen ittwasel s umata seg berra.

week32.0: Aqcic yebna yakan mliḥ yerna ittbedu ad yeṭṭef tallit n uqerru ɣer wadda i yeqqnen i tlalit. Yettkemmil ad yettaru azal deg ddasen i d-yeqqimen.
week32.3: Uzal d ayen ittbin ugar d ayen imatu deg tallit-a, i yeqqnen ɣer uɣelnaw n uqcic.
week32.4: Allen n uqerru ɣer wadda (taskant n uqerru) tettuɣal d ayen imatu ugar ticki yeqreb wass n tlalit.

week33.0: Aɣerrabu d unagraw n tawwurt xedmen yakan mliḥ. Iɛeḍman ttkemmilen ad ttwaḥeṭṭren, ɣer wid n ukerru i yeqqimen d imɣuyen akken ad yessinen tuffɣa deg tlalit.
week33.3: Ugzam n usmuggi n tallit n nnuba yelhan d ayen imatu deg tallit-a.
week33.4: Taɣuyi n iɛeḍman n uqerru deg tlalit d taɛeddit yerna tettwaqqen cwiṭ cwiṭ deg useggas amezwaru.
